name: @deliveryproof/rail-erc8183-base
description: First DeliveryProof RailAdapter for the ERC-8183 (Agentic Commerce) evaluator slot: reads an already-funded Submitted job and releases (complete) or refunds (reject) escrow from a signed DeliveryProof receipt. Evaluator only — never funds, custodies, or submits. Testnet/local only. viem is an optional, lazily imported dependency.

scripts.check: find src test examples -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
